4050-7084-8293.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Phyrexian Altar ability.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Cleveland Booker triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Phyrexian Altar ability.
Repeat.

413-2393-2738-4871.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Sifter of Skulls, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls trigger, creating a creature token.
When the token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 6.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Tenacious Dead enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

5147-5170-6132-7574.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Sultai Flayer triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Sultai Flayer trigger.
Resolve the Sultai Flayer trigger, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

4289-6791-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
4289-6791-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
4289-6791-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to HYDRA Assault Robot with "Pirate" chosen

4508-7040-7746.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
4508-7040-7746.description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
HYDRA Assault Robot triggers, dealing 1 damage to target opponent.
Malcolm triggers, as HYDRA Assault Robot is a Pirate due to Psychic Paper, creating a Treasure token
When the Treasure enters, HYDRA Assault Robot triggers, dealing 1 damage to target opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

339-677-5434-6797.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

549-3259-5434-5953.easyPrerequisites: Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control.
549-3259-5434-5953.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
549-3259-5434-5953.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Aya of Alexandria trigger.
Resolve the Aya of Alexandria trigger, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2034-4840-7282.description:
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Myr Battlesphere with haste.
When Myr Battlesphere enters, it triggers, creating four creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing four creature tokens, adding six {C}.
Repeat from step 2.

573-1558-3875-4231-4772.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
573-1558-3875-4231-4772.description:
Play Gruul Turf.
When Gruul Turf enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Doubling Season.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1322-3094-4659-5390-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
1322-3094-4659-5390-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {2} due to Forensic Gadgeteer and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed, targeting Lithoform Engine.
Resolve the copy of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine from your graveyard to the battlefield as a 3/3 Robot artifact creature.
Repeat from step 2.

2510-4050-4907-6989.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact and/or creature card exiled with Semblance Anvil.

4050-4681-5170-6634.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Al Bhed Salvagers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Al Bhed Salvagers trigger.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

413-643-2366-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
413-643-2366-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Blasting Station and Haru trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Haru trigger, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 one additional time.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 6.
Repeat from step 5.

1651-3875-5967-6751-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-3875-5967-6751-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1651-3875-5967-6751-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner triggers twice due to Starfield Vocalist, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

56-792-5256-6887.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional untapped black and/or green creature.
56-792-5256-6887.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Totentanz and The Skullspore Nexus trigger, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five cards from your graveyard and tapping two black and/or green creatures you control.
Repeat.
56-792-5256-6887.notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

880-3703-6763.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-3703-6763.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When the land enters the battlefield, Sporemound triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1061-1379-4231-5469-6727.description:
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it from the battlefield onto the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Transmutation Font's first ability by tapping it, creating a Food, a Clue and a Treasure token.
Activate Kuldotha Forgemaster by tapping it, sacrificing the Food, the Clue and the Treasure, putting Timestream Navigator from your library onto the battlefield.
Repeat each turn.

803-3951-4772-5703.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr
803-3951-4772-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating two tapped and attacking copies of Éomer.
Put all but one Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing you to get at least one Éomer trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

1947-2916-5856.easyPrerequisites:
Reckless Barbarian exiled by Hazel's Brewmaster.
You control a Food.
1947-2916-5856.description:
Activate a Food using Pippin's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a Food token.
Activate the Food tapped in step 1 using Reckless Barbarian's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

101-3821-6485.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{G}{U}.
101-3821-6485.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{G}{U}.
Cast Rally the Galadhrim by paying {2}{G}{U} and tapping Vampire Charmseeker and Peregrine Drake, targeting Vampire Charmseeker
Rally the Galadhrim's conspire ability triggers, copying it, targeting Peregrine Drake.
Resolve the copy of Rally the Galadhrim, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake.
When the Peregrine Drake token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Resolve the original Rally the Galadhrim, creating a token copy of Vampire Charmseeker.
When the Vampire Charmseeker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Rally the Galadhrim from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, tapping the Vampire Charmseeker and Peregrine Drake tokens when casting Rally the Galadhrim instead.

uses.n: Optimus Prime, Hero // Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader

628-5147-5263.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Hero.
When Optimus Prime, Hero dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader dies, Mikaeus triggers, returning Optimus Prime from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Hero with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve both Goblin Bombardment abilities from steps 1 and 3, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1636-5914-5915.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature with greater mana value than Stickytongue Sentinel that can be cast using only mana creatures you control can produce.
1636-5914-5915.description:
Activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Stickytongue Sentinel.
Cast Stickytongue Sentinel by paying its mana cost.
When Stickytongue Sentinel enters the battlefield, it, Clement and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Clement trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Stickytongue Sentinel trigger, returning the other creature with greater mana value from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast the creature returned to your hand.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Clement and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Clement trigger, returning Stickytongue Sentinel from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
1636-5914-5915.notes: You can tap Frogs for mana thanks to Clement. This should be factored in when determining if you have enough mana to execute the combo.

1527-4365-4911.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls an indestructible creature, or you have a way to give an opponent's creature indestructible.
You control a number of artifacts greater than two times the indestructible creature's toughness.
1527-4365-4911.description:
Give an opponent's creature indestructible, if needed.
Activate Ghirapur Aether Grid by tapping two artifacts you control, dealing 1 damage to an indestructible creature an opponent controls.
If the creature has less than 0 toughness, Magmatic Galleon's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Repeat from step 2.

2232-2537-3604-4939.description:
Cast Ghalta by paying {5}{G}{G}{G}.
When Ghalta enters the battlefield, it, Cadric and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Burning-Tree Emissary to your hand if its on the battlefield, or returning nothing to your hand otherwise.
Resolve the Ghalta trigger, putting Burning-Tree Emissary onto the battlefield from your hand.
When Burning-Tree Emissary enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Burning-Tree Emissary trigger, adding {R}{G}.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Ghalta to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Cadric trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Ghalta with haste.
When the Ghalta token enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Ghalta token's trigger, putting Ghalta onto the battlefield from your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

974-2487-3008-4222.notablePrerequisites:
There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
Flamewright does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Flamewright.
974-2487-3008-4222.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Activate Flamewright's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a 1/1 Construct creature token.
Activate Blade of Shared Souls' equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to the Construct token.
Blade of Shared Souls triggers, causing the Construct to become a copy of Smaug for as long as Blade of Shared Souls is attached to it.
Put the Construct token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Construct dies, it triggers, creating fourteen Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Flamewright.
Repeat from step 3.
Once you have infinite mana, you may simply tap and untap Flamewright to get infinite Construct tokens, and then use its second ability to sacrifice them for infinite damage.

829-1528-5195.notablePrerequisites: Dual Casting attached to a creature you control without summoning sickness.
829-1528-5195.description:
Cast Sibling Rivalry by paying {3}{R}, targeting any applicable permanent.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Activate the creature with Dual Casting attached by paying {R} and tapping it, copying Sibling Rivalry, targeting the creature with Dual Casting attached.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of Sibling Rivalry, untapping the creature with Dual Casting attached and creating a tapped Powerstone artifact token.
Repeat from step 3.

1300-2816-4050-4459.notablePrerequisites:
Umbral Mantle attached to Weaver of Harmony.
Weaver of Harmony does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least five other Shrines.
1300-2816-4050-4459.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Go-Shintai triggers.
Holding priority, activate Weaver of Harmony by paying {G} and tapping it, copying Go-Shintai's ability.
Resolve the copy of Go-Shintai's ability, paying {1} to create at least six 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar five times by sacrificing five Spirit tokens, adding {4}{G}.
Activate Weaver of Harmony by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 2.

36-38-401.description:
Cast Mogg War Marshal, creating a 1/1 Goblin when it enters the battlefield.
Sacrifice Mogg War Marshal to the Skirk Prospector, generating {R}, triggering Decaying Soil's ability, and creating another 1/1 Goblin.
Use the {R} to pay for Decaying Soil's ability to return Mogg War Marshal to hand.
Sacrifice the 2 Goblin tokens to Skirk Prospector to generate {R}{R} to recast Mogg War Marshal.
Repeat.

3762-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Oasis Ritualist.
Oasis Ritualist does not have summoning sickness.
3762-4222.description:
Activate Oasis Ritualist's second ability by tapping and exerting it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Oasis Ritualist.
Repeat
